<template>
  <v-container fluid>
    <v-row>
      <v-col cols="12" md="4">
        <SummaryCard :summary="summary" />
      </v-col>
      <v-col cols="12" md="8">
        <v-row>
          <v-col cols="12" md="4">
            <BreakdownChart title="Asset Type" :data="assetTypeData" />
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" md="4">
            <BreakdownChart title="Asset Class" :data="assetClassData" />
          </v-col>
          <v-col cols="12" md="4">
            <BreakdownChart title="Currency" :data="currencyData" />
          </v-col>
        </v-row>
      </v-col>
    </v-row>
    <v-row>
      <v-col cols="12">
        <SummaryOverTimeTable :data="summaryOverTimeData" />
        <SummaryOverTimeTable :lines="summaryOverTimeData.lines" :years="summaryOverTimeData.years" :currentYear="currentYear" />
    
      </v-col>
    </v-row>
    <v-row>
      <v-col cols="12">
        <NAVChart :data="NAVChartData" />
      </v-col>
    </v-row>
  </v-container>
</template>

<script>
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue'
import SummaryCard from '@/components/dashboard/SummaryCard.vue'
import BreakdownChart from '@/components/dashboard/BreakdownChart.vue'
import SummaryOverTimeTable from '@/components/dashboard/SummaryOverTimeTable.vue'
import NAVChart from '@/components/dashboard/NAVChart.vue'
import { getDashboardData, getChartData } from '@/services/api'

export default {
  name: 'DashboardPage',
  components: {
    SummaryCard,
    BreakdownChart,
    SummaryOverTimeTable,
    NAVChart,
  },
  setup() {
    const summary = ref({})
    const assetTypeData = ref({})
    const assetClassData = ref({})
    const currencyData = ref({})
    const summaryOverTimeData = ref({})
    const navChartData = ref({})
    const currentYear = ref('')

    const fetchDashboardData = async () => {
      try {
        const data = await getDashboardData()
        summary.value = data.summary
        assetTypeData.value = data.assetTypeData
        assetClassData.value = data.assetClassData
        currencyData.value = data.currencyData
        summaryOverTimeData.value = data.summaryOverTimeData
        navChartData.value = data.navChartData
        currentYear.value = data.currentYear
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error fetching dashboard data:', error)
      }
    }

    const updateNAVChart = async (params) => {
      try {
        const data = await getChartData(params)
        navChartData.value = data
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Error updating NAV chart data:', error)
      }
    }

    onMounted(fetchDashboardData)

    return {
      summary,
      assetTypeData,
      assetClassData,
      currencyData,
      summaryOverTimeData,
      navChartData,
      currentYear,
      updateNAVChart,
    }
  },
}
</script>
